behavior_notes.normalization: Pinned Bevy 0.19.1/glam 0.33.6 source read only: Dir3 divides by length; successful Vec3 try_normalize uses the same reciprocal multiplication as prior normalize. Optional grass retains normalize_or_zero. Degenerate/nonfinite required normals now reject.
behavior_notes.signed_zero: Original grass centre used local + Vec2::ZERO while mesh/rock centre used local directly. For admitted sampled grids width/depth >=2, bilinear grid coordinates add positive half-grid extents >=0.5, eliminating any difference in a signed zero before sampling/fraction arithmetic. Seam outside-distance uses abs/max; sampled SceneTerrain adds its positive half extent. Owned grass bypasses this aggregate. No valid height/normal/mesh/seed output difference follows from that centre-expression difference. Native normal-probe offset order and f32 interpolation formulas are otherwise preserved.
behavior_notes.offset_origins: LOD scene_point/local_offset preserve old addition/subtraction and f64-to-f32 order. Existing 500/500 inspection and 125/-275 pigment fixtures are preserved. ActiveVistaSurface retains its previous numeric seam policy; this change does not silently correct the old offset-ring interpretation.
behavior_notes.invalid_coarse: Nonfinite coarse native samples remain Some until the completed interpolation is rejected. Malformed coarse metadata is distinct from exterior missing samples and is rejected before fallback/indexing.
